purpose: A DSPy-style, CLI-neutral signature and metric contract for turning selected JCC runtime context into one AI-native coach answer.
design_source: Inspired by DSPy signatures/metrics, but kept as a product contract instead of a hot-path Python dependency.

runtime_shape.provider_session_policy: one persistent lobby provider process/session per app opening and one persistent match provider process/session per Start Match; repeated turns reuse the live owning session, and resume is crash/recovery only

interaction_event_contract.visible_coach_answer_definition: A strategy-bearing coach final_text. Operational system status may be shown separately, but it must not contain a second strategy answer.

direct_user_message.failure_policy: report the owned task failure; do not replay latest_user_intent_changed or target_plan_changed as automatic cruise answers

latest_user_intent_changed.meaning: observable interaction context from the latest user message

target_plan_changed.must_not_include: ordinary lineup, economy, or item questions that only mention a possible line

confirmation_only_interaction.status_policy: a factual confirmation status may be shown immediately, but it is not a strategy answer
confirmation_only_interaction.delivery_trigger: persist the canonical choice only; later explicit advice and fixed checkpoints read it

manual_match_variables.response_owner: none at confirmation time; the next user-owned advice or fixed strategic checkpoint absorbs the opening-variable judgment
manual_match_variables.delivery_trigger: persist variables immediately without opening or reserving a Host lane
manual_match_variables.first_augment_scope: preselection ranks the three augments and refresh decision using the variables; candidate lineup directions begin only after the first augment is confirmed

match_fact_capture.entry_authority: explicit Cruise Quick Record control only; matching visible text in ordinary chat is never sufficient
match_fact_capture.host_role: propose closed-schema normalized fact operations only
match_fact_capture.runtime_role: resolve, validate, persist one sparse current-match patch, and replace model wording with a receipt of actual accepted and unresolved facts

interaction_event_contract.proactive_followup: A structured semantic decision event may open one later Host response after deterministic facts are committed. The follow-up is the main model's strategy judgment over the latest selected live state, rules, rankings, target, choices, and missing facts; it is not a second answer to the original interaction. Field mutations alone do not open a host response lane.

choice_card_final_confirmation.final_confirm_response_owner: none for confirmation-only; a separate explicit advice request owns its normal Host response
choice_card_final_confirmation.duplicate_confirmation_policy: return already-recorded status without opening a Host task or appending a duplicate fact

choice_card_advice_action.response_owner: one structured_card_action task in the registered backend choice mode
choice_card_advice_action.renderer_action: one unified 获取建议 action; there is no separate choice-only versus whole-card choice advice button
choice_card_advice_action.candidate_authority: the exact canonical reported_choice_set submitted by the current card action
choice_card_advice_action.selected_context: exact candidates plus all reliable canonical variables, shared equipment, chat intent, target plan, live state, rules, and current-day rankings
choice_card_advice_action.missing_equipment_policy: equipment is useful but optional; answer without it and mention only a missing equipment fact that would materially change the choice
choice_card_advice_action.output_focus: focus on the current choice even though the input context is complete; augment preselection must include both candidate ranking and an explicit keep/refresh action
choice_card_advice_action.automatic_cruise_policy: not an automatic cruise task; choice-window reservation and cross-stage proactive expiry must not cancel it
choice_card_advice_action.delivery_policy: deliver exactly once, acknowledge, then return the choice mode to cruise
choice_card_advice_action.status_ping_policy: punctuation-only status checks observe this owner without opening or preempting another response task

structured_context_semantics: stage_round in game_state_brief and game_rule_contract is the authoritative current game stage for this answer.
active_rules_bundle explains the game mechanics; game_state_brief applies those mechanics to the current match snapshot.
coach_rules_brief.stage_decision_tasks explains what the coach should do at the current stage before falling back to generic transition advice.
coach_rules_brief.decision_model.context_priority explains which facts dominate when live_state, user intent, and backend drafts conflict.
match_facts are match-session memory owned by JCC Runtime. Newer recent_user_messages and choice_confirmations supersede older conflicting intentions.
strategy_wiki_context contains curated published strategy memory. It is a soft prior below current live_state, active rules, current-season hard data, daily big data, and newer user intent.

Every active choice mechanic obeys its compiled candidate_input_policy. Current product augment, item/anvil, and active-season choice candidate sets come only from the current-match user report; candidates are not proof of what the user finally selected.

Ordinary chat may update latest user intent and provisional target context, but it never writes candidate sets, final choices, equipment, or match variables. The explicit match_fact_capture request kind is a separate authorized fact-only path; Runtime validates every proposed operation against current catalogs and descriptors before persistence. Structured cards remain the normal direct editing path.
Backend scorer output is evidence for ranking and action candidates. It is not the visible coach voice in manual user-choice mode.
latest_user_intent is the raw/provisional user interaction context; target_plan is a separately sourced durable plan fact. A lineup-related question must not silently become a confirmed target plan.

When no durable target_plan exists, latest_target_intent may participate in strategy-fit, economy, equipment, and later event decisions only with provisional_user_intent authority; it does not create a response lane or silently become confirmed.

Static common, season, hard-data, daily-ranking, wiki, and economy context may be bootstrapped once per provider-session fingerprint. A changed fingerprint replaces that capsule once inside the same live owning session instead of creating or resuming a provider session; dynamic current facts must still be supplied on every turn.
JCC Runtime SQLite state is the source of truth; provider session memory is cache only and cannot recover or overwrite runtime-owned facts.
Active augment, item/anvil, and active-season choice cards use structured user card reports as candidate context; OCR or vision output cannot supply candidate names for those active product flows.

Augment Quick OCR is a renderer-draft convenience only. The shared resident worker may be warmed once at Start Match, but OCR output remains local until the player submits and confirms the structured card.

effective_equipment is the shared per-field equipment context. Use trusted structured MuMu fields first, then current-match user confirmation, then explicit fallback candidates; never wait for lower-priority sources after a sufficient confirmed field is present.

Whole-snapshot equipment confirmation is a fact-only current-match action available after daemon-owned equipment hydration; it persists despite a missing or stale surrounding choice-set binding, does not create a Host response task, and never treats an unhydrated renderer default as an explicit empty inventory. Whole-equipment advice is a separate explicit interaction with exactly one Host response owner.

Candidate-bearing structured-card submissions require the current canonical choice-set revision. Only final confirmation may rebase a stale same-match/same-stage/same-kind binding, and only when exact slot plus ref/name identity still matches the current canonical set.

A final-confirm success status is truthful only after canonical choice persistence succeeds. Confirmation-only is a state update and never opens a Host response task; later explicit advice and fixed strategic checkpoints read the confirmed choice from canonical state.

Proactive delivery validity is decision-scoped. Non-durable proactive answers fail closed when the current stage is unavailable. Decision-stable events compare their own action fingerprint and may ignore unrelated live-state churn; scorer-driven events recompute that fingerprint in the same registered decision-trigger domain used at admission. Exact shop and bench events require their material fingerprints and fail closed when those fingerprints are unavailable.
Manual round selector values are current-match user-confirmed phase context; rank tier selector values are user settings. They are not strategy answers and must not create Host sibling tasks.

A missing choice is blocking only when the active user request asks which option to take in that exact choice window. For lineup, economy, item, target, or other user-owned actions in any stage, answer first and attach the missing choice as conditional uncertainty or a card reminder.

Target-role semantics are part of retrieval identity. Main-carry intent must not be satisfied by a lineup where the champion is only a member or trait activator; national Master+ strength, winning-lineup recipe evidence, and hero-market/item evidence remain provenance-distinct.

A selected strategy_profile canonical_variant is one atomic published roster. Every sibling variant and mature recipe variant remains a separately named atomic alternative, and every nested transition remains attached to its exact parent; population does not classify source role. Live adjustments must name explicit one-for-one substitutions.

strategy_profile.equipment_requirements separates variant-specific explicit upstream requirements, full-variant-consensus group requirements, formation-required emblems, and non-mandatory published core consensus. Required advice names the holder; an external-holder emblem also names the granted trait and lineup-formation effect only after the current trait catalog resolves that grant uniquely. Missing or ambiguous grants fail closed. Item preference then falls through to published recipe, hero core, highest-top-one, and most-popular evidence.

Craftability is exact current-patch hard-data evidence. An item may be described as craftable only when it appears in component_recipe_contexts for the named owned component; desired traits or lineup fit cannot synthesize an unlisted emblem or recipe.

required_semantics: Current-match user-reported choices are candidate options, not confirmed selected choices.
Answer the user's active question before cruise/background advice.
Use the current stage and forbidden_waiting_for list before generic game knowledge.
Use coach_rules_brief.stage_decision_tasks[current_stage] before generic transition or economy advice.
If game_rule_contract marks the current stage as a choice checkpoint, answer that choice now and do not tell the user to wait for it.
For augment preselection at any registered augment checkpoint, explain the ranking in final_text and return only the minimal choice_handoff needed for the UI selection or refresh action.
If a declared choice checkpoint is past and its selected option is unknown, ask what was selected or state the selection is unknown.
If the answer arrives after the transient window, still answer the user and mention the snapshot when useful.
output_fields: choice_handoff only when Runtime must apply a UI selection or refresh action
manual_augment_choice.visible_fast_hint_policy: Manual mode should prefer AI-native host output. Deterministic scorer evidence may be included in the host request, but should not replace the final model answer unless the product explicitly enables emergency fast hints.

required_semantics: Speak only when new evidence materially changes advice or a high-value event fires.
Do not repeat a semantically equivalent suggestion for the same stage/economy/action state.
Do not say to wait for a choice checkpoint that is current or already past.
Use current stage_round from game_state_brief as stronger evidence than old phrasing in backend drafts.
Use coach_rules_brief.stage_decision_tasks[current_stage] to decide whether this stage calls for economy, choice, board, item, or missing-information behavior.
Ask the user for missing final selections from active major-season choice mechanics when those facts affect the next decision.
When runtime_event_context is present, answer that exact semantic event once. Treat parallel scorer tasks as evidence, not independent answer owners.

When a target line exists, proactively surface the one or two most actionable decisions among economy/roll timing, key units to hold or seek, item slam or holder, future choice priorities, and commit-or-pivot conditions.

Do not invent a win/loss streak. Use a structured streak fact or explicit user plan when present; otherwise ask one focused question only when streak posture would materially change the current action.
output_fields: candidate_refs only when Runtime must preserve or materialize exact Ranking identities

required_semantics: Use only current-season champion names from season_catalog.
Prefer data-backed similar candidates before inventing a fresh comp.

Return a minimal lineup_handoff when the active mode is lineup_card or the direct user message explicitly asks Runtime to materialize a lineup/board/card. Ordinary lineup discussion remains text advice and needs no handoff.
Use selected_ranking_candidates, daily_big_data, current match variables, confirmed choices, live_state, and latest user intent to choose the lineup instead of only paraphrasing the user's text.
Explain main carry items, moves, leveling and positioning priorities in final_text when they matter.

Do not hand-write renderer coordinates, canonical rosters, loadouts, or card layout. Runtime restores authoritative candidate facts and Renderer builds the card. Missing optional handoff details must not suppress usable final_text.
output_fields: lineup_handoff with target identity and semantic adjustments

lineup_handoff_contract.materialization_policy: Runtime restores canonical roster, population, carries, equipment and trusted positioning; Renderer owns card layout.
lineup_handoff_contract.degradation_policy: A missing or incomplete handoff skips or degrades card publication but never suppresses usable final_text.

rule_timing_correctness: Never says to wait for a choice checkpoint that game_rule_contract marks current or past.
Uses the active major-season normal and special rules for checkpoint timing instead of hardcoded stage memory.
Treats minor-patch strategy as a soft prior that cannot redefine game-rule timing.
choice_fact_correctness: Distinguishes current-match user-reported candidate sets from confirmed final selections.
Asks for an unknown final selected choice when that fact affects later advice.
current_season_correctness: Uses current-season catalog and current-season special rules when attached.
context_recency: Latest user intent overrides older conflicting target plans.
Newer choice confirmations override older candidate observations.

Cruise output should not display expired proactive advice. Freshness is decision-scoped: non-durable advice requires a current stage, unrelated live-state churn must not cancel a stable economy, tempo, lineup-direction, or equipment action, and scorer-driven advice must retain its registered decision-trigger fingerprint domain; a newer same-family decision, an exact shop/bench change, a choice boundary, or a major-stage boundary makes the older action stale.
answer_shape: Chinese final_text is short and actionable.
Explains what to do, why now, evidence used, and uncertainty only as needed.
Does not expose raw ranking ids or backend scorer internals.
One user interaction produces at most one strategy-bearing coach answer; derived intent and target-plan context cannot create sibling automatic answers.
Choice-card final confirmation is state-only; explicit card advice and fixed strategic checkpoints use the canonical response-task delivery path.

dependency_policy.allowed_future_use: offline prompt/signature optimization and eval-set tuning
dependency_policy.reason: Hot match advice must stay CLI-neutral and low-latency. Runtime contracts should be plain JSON selected context that any host CLI agent can consume.
